store.name: WonderFold Australia
store.who: Official Australian home of WonderFold stroller wagons, exclusively distributed by Coolkidz Australia Pty Ltd, 1 Beyer Road, Braeside VIC 3195. Orders ship from the Braeside warehouse and every warranty claim is handled by the Braeside team.
store.showroom: 1 Beyer Road, Braeside VIC 3195, Monday to Friday 9:30am to 2:30pm. Warehouse pickup 7am to 3pm weekdays.
store.origin: WonderFold began in Southern California in 2019 with a folding utility wagon; parents kept putting their kids in it, so the stroller wagon was born. Sold in more than ten countries.
store.naming: Write WonderFold with a capital F. Models: W2, W4, W6. Finishes: Elite, Luxe, Luxe Pro.

range.shared: Every WonderFold stroller wagon has raised, reclining, removable seats with padded 5-point harnesses, a removable UPF 50+ canopy on adjustable poles, a front zip door, mesh sides and a roll-out wind/privacy shade, pockets on every side and a rear basket, a one-step foot brake (red on AU models), an optional pull strap, and folds to stand on its own. Suitable from 6 months in the seats, or from birth with a compatible infant capsule on the W2 or W4 car seat adapter. Every model and finish sold in Australia is certified to AS 2088:2022 / A1:2024, the Australian standard for prams and strollers. One honest price, no was prices.
range.W2: Two seats. Best for most families with two children: lighter, shorter, easier in shop aisles and smaller boots. 91 kg total. W2 Elite $1,299 (Charcoal Grey, Volcanic Black), 25 kg, 20 kg per seat. W2 Luxe $1,399 (Volcanic Black, Charcoal Grey), 24 kg, 20 kg per seat. W2 Luxe Pro $1,499 (Jet Black), 22.3 kg, 22 kg per seat, 76.2 cm at its widest.
range.W4: Four seats on two benches. For three or four children, or two with another on the way. 136 kg total, 45 kg per bench, 74 cm at its widest, inside 84 x 53 cm. W4 Elite $1,499 (Volcanic Black, Charcoal Grey), 26.3 kg. W4 Luxe $1,799 (Volcanic Black, Charcoal Grey), weight to be confirmed. W4 Luxe Pro $1,999 (Jet Black), 24.5 kg, folded 113 x 74 x 51 cm.
range.W6: Six seats on three benches, Luxe Pro only, $1,999 (Jet Black), 31.8 kg, 140 kg total, 45 kg per bench, 74 cm wide, dual faux-leather handlebars. For big families, multiples and early-learning groups. No AU car seat adapter for the W6 yet.
range.finishes: Elite: all-terrain EVA wheels, neoprene handlebar cover, padded 5-point harness; XL wheels can be added later ($379). Luxe: all-terrain XL wheels with suspension, vegan-leather handlebar, magnetic 5-point harness, extra front pocket. Luxe Pro: lighter aluminium frame, seats that can face forward or face the parent, lockable front wheels, faux-leather handlebar, insulated rear cooler basket (5 kg cooler, 1 kg mesh).
range.volkswagen: W4 Volkswagen special edition in Bondi Blue, $1,999, four seats, VW bumper, working headlights, retro XL wheels. Exclusive to Coolkidz Australia. Currently out of stock.
range.not_sizes: Folded sizes for the W2, W6, Elite and Luxe are being confirmed; do not guess them.

choosing: Choose size first, then finish. One child: most families do not need a wagon; W2 if they carry a lot. Two children: W2, unless another baby is likely soon (then W4). Three or four: W4. Five or six, multiples or early-learning groups: W6. Finish by where they walk: footpaths and shops suit Elite; beach, grass and gravel suit Luxe or Luxe Pro (XL wheels); babies under 12 months suit Luxe Pro (seats can face you). Under 6 months: a compatible capsule on the car seat adapter. Before buying, measure the boot: a folded W4 Luxe Pro is 113 x 74 x 51 cm.
accessories: Car seat adapter for W2 or W4, $189.95; compatible capsules: Maxi-Cosi Mico 6, Mico 12 and AP/Plus, Joie i-Gemm, Nuna Pipa, Cybex Cloud Q. Flex Canopy W2 or W4 $199.95. All Terrain XL Wheels $379. W4 single seat $127.45 (frees floor space). Weather, wind, winter, rain and travel covers, shadenets, mosquito nets, snack trays, all-weather mats, shopping baskets, pram organisers and a cup and phone holder. Only recommend accessories that appear in the live product list.

policies.shipping: Express shipping Australia-wide; rates and any free-shipping threshold are shown at checkout. Free pickup from 1 Beyer Road, Braeside VIC, usually ready within 24 hours. Same-day delivery in selected Melbourne areas (see the same-day delivery terms page).
policies.returns: Australian Consumer Law always applies. Faulty or wrong item: tell us within 48 hours of delivery; we issue a return authority within 1 to 2 working days, then replace, repair or refund. Change of mind: exchange or store credit within 7 days of purchase, unused, unopened, in original packaging with proof of purchase. Not eligible: gift cards, clearance and special orders. Do not send items back without a return authority.
policies.warranty: One-year manufacturer warranty on every wagon. Register within three months for a one-time 10% off accessories code. Spare parts (wheels, brakes, canopy poles and fabric, seats) are available after the warranty ends; the team quotes them.

programs.warriors: WonderFold Warriors: a discount on wagons for families whose child has been professionally assessed as benefiting from a WonderFold (emotionally, physically, socially or psychologically), including mobility challenges, sensory sensitivities, physical disabilities, neurodivergent needs and anxiety. A medical practitioner signs the application form; purchases are made through customer service; not available on NDIA-managed plans, self-managed NDIS welcome. The discount amount is confirmed by the team.
programs.ndis: We can prepare quotes and invoices for NDIS participants and plan managers. Whether a WonderFold is funded is a decision for the NDIA with the family's plan and therapist; never say it will be funded.
programs.whisperers: WonderFold Whisperers: real families who share honest experience with other families. Apply on the Whisperers page.
programs.starlight: WonderFold Australia proudly supports Starlight Children's Foundation; customers can add a $2, $5 or $10 donation at checkout.

retail: Also at authorised retailers including Baby Bunting, Myer, Harvey Norman and Big W, plus independent baby stores, and at Source Kids expos. Stock varies by store; suggest calling ahead.

faq.q: Will a WonderFold fit through a doorway?
faq.a: Yes. The W4 and W6 are 74 cm at their widest and the W2 Luxe Pro 76.2 cm, which fits a standard Australian internal door.
Wipe the frame with a soft towel, lukewarm water and a mild cleaner, then dry. Rinse dirt off the wheels. Spot clean the fabric with mild soap and warm water and air dry.
No. WonderFold stroller wagons are not medical devices or mobility aids. Many families with children who have additional needs choose one for its space and easy entry.
Hard, packed sand near the water is fine, especially with XL wheels (Luxe and Luxe Pro); soft dry sand is hard work for any wagon. The included pull strap helps on rough ground.
Check the dispatch email for tracking, or call 1300 722 302 with the order number.
